pageLede: Choose comprehensive support for the full application, focused coaching for a shorter school list, or expert feedback on an existing draft. Andrea also works with educational consultants who need dependable editorial support.
localIntro: Based in New Canaan, Andrea works with students across Fairfield County and with applicants nationwide.
processMuted: Two ways to work together. Both end with an essay the student wrote and can talk about in an interview.

coachingSteps.title: Brainstorm
coachingSteps.description: A conversation about who the student is and what they care about. Out of it comes a shortlist of topics that are theirs.

coachingSteps.title: Outline and draft
coachingSteps.description: A structure for the essay, then a first draft written by the student, with Andrea on call while they write.

coachingSteps.title: Comment
coachingSteps.description: Margin comments on content, structure and reflection. What works, what is missing, what to cut, and why.

coachingSteps.title: Edit and finalize
coachingSteps.description: Line edits for language, style and grammar, then a last read for word count and polish.

commentingSteps.title: Comment
commentingSteps.description: Andrea reads the draft and sends back detailed comments on content and organization.

commentingSteps.title: Revise
commentingSteps.description: The student revises, in their own words.

commentingSteps.title: Final edit
commentingSteps.description: A language and style edit. The essay is ready to submit.

services.name: The Golden Ticket
services.summary: Everything written in the application, coached one-on-one. Up to fifteen schools.
services.detail: Five 60-minute video sessions plus unlimited document exchange by email. Andrea starts with college application strategy (which schools, which essays, what order) and a résumé (your child's teachers will want it for recommendation letters anyway), then runs the essay process for the Common App and every supplement on the list: topic brainstorm, outline, drafts, comments, edits. It ends with two hours of college interview practice and honest notes. UC and USC count as two schools each. Extra schools are available à la carte.
services.keywords: college admissions consulting, college application package, college essay coaching

services.name: Quick Silver
services.summary: The essays and one mock interview. Up to eight schools.
services.detail: Three 60-minute video sessions plus document exchange. Same essay process as the Golden Ticket, for a shorter school list: brainstorm, structure, drafts, comments and final edits on the personal statement and supplements, then a one-hour interview simulation. A good fit for students who already have a résumé and a clear list.
services.keywords: college essay coaching package, personal statement coaching

services.name: À la carte
services.summary: One school at a time. One 45-minute call, two rounds of comments, one round of edits per essay.
services.detail: For a single supplement, a transfer application, a scholarship essay, or a school added late in the season. Also how packages extend past their school limit.
services.keywords: supplemental essay help, why this school essay

services.name: Essay commenting and editing
services.summary: Already have a draft? Send it for a college application review. Comments back within 72 hours.
services.detail: College essay editing at two levels. Commenting covers content and structure: what works, what is missing, what to cut, and why. Editing covers language, style and grammar on a draft the student has already revised. Most families do both, in that order. Works for the Common App personal statement, UC Personal Insight Questions, supplements, and graduate school statements of purpose.
services.keywords: college admissions essay editing, personal statement review, statement of purpose editing

services.name: Graduate school statements
services.summary: Statements of purpose and personal statements for master's, MBA, law, medical and PhD programs.
services.detail: Graduate school admissions consulting for the written part of the application: MBA essays, law school personal statements, medical school personal statements and secondaries, and statements of purpose for master's and PhD programs. Committees want fit and direction, not a résumé rewritten as paragraphs. Andrea helps applicants connect their background, their work and their goals into a statement that reads like a plan. Same comment-then-edit process.
services.keywords: graduate school admission essay editing, MBA essay editing, law school personal statement

services.name: Résumé development
services.summary: A clean one-page college application resume, or a graduate school resume review for applicants who already have one.
services.detail: Built from scratch or tightened from a draft, and formatted so the strongest experience is impossible to miss. It also feeds the Common App activities list and the essays, so everything tells one story.

services.name: Interview preparation
services.summary: College interview prep over video: mock alumni and admissions interviews, with notes afterward.
services.detail: Students practice the questions they will get, the ones they should ask, and how to talk about themselves without sounding rehearsed. Especially useful for international applicants interviewing in English.
services.keywords: college admissions interview prep, college interview questions

services.name: B2B editing for consultants
services.summary: White-label commenting, editing and coaching for independent educational consultants and agencies.
services.detail: Since 2015 Andrea has handled the writing component for consulting companies in the U.S. and Asia, reviewing and editing thousands of essays a year on their behalf. Pick a level per student: a one-time language and style edit, content comments before edits, or full coaching from brainstorm to final draft. You keep the client relationship. She keeps the 72-hour turnaround.
services.keywords: B2B essay editing, independent educational consultant partner, white-label essay editing

services.name: Workshops and teaching
services.summary: Intensive writing and literary-analysis workshops for schools, agencies and small groups.
services.detail: Andrea teaches personal statement workshops around the world and keynotes educational consulting conferences in China. Workshops also cover the academic writing students need once they get to campus.
services.keywords: college essay workshop, personal statement workshop
